entries.title: Colossians 3:1
segments: ¶If then you have a new life with Christ, give your attention to the things of heaven, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

entries.title: Colossians 3:2
segments: Keep your mind on the higher things, not on the things of earth.

entries.title: Colossians 3:3
segments: For your life on earth is done, and you have a secret life with Christ in God.

entries.title: Colossians 3:4
segments: At the coming of Christ who is our life, you will be seen with him in glory.

entries.title: Colossians 3:5
segments: ¶Then put to death your bodies which are of the earth; wrong use of the flesh, unclean things, passion, evil desires and envy, which is the worship of strange gods;

entries.title: Colossians 3:6
segments: Because of which the wrath of God comes on those who go against his orders;

entries.title: Colossians 3:7
segments: Among whom you were living in the past, when you did such things.

entries.title: Colossians 3:8
segments: ¶But now it is right for you to put away all these things; wrath, passion, bad feeling, curses, unclean talk;

entries.title: Colossians 3:9
segments: Do not make false statements to one another; because you have put away the old man with all his doings,

entries.title: Colossians 3:10
segments: And have put on the new man, which has become new in knowledge after the image of his maker;

entries.title: Colossians 3:11
segments: Where there is no Greek or Jew, no one with circumcision or without circumcision, no division between nations, no servant or free man: but Christ is all and in all.

entries.title: Colossians 3:12
segments: ¶As saints of God, then, holy and dearly loved, let your behaviour be marked by pity and mercy, kind feeling, a low opinion of yourselves, gentle ways, and a power of undergoing all things;

entries.title: Colossians 3:13
segments: Being gentle to one another and having forgiveness for one another, if anyone has done wrong to his brother, even as the Lord had forgiveness for you:

entries.title: Colossians 3:14
segments: And more than all, have love; the only way in which you may be completely joined together.

entries.title: Colossians 3:15
segments: And let the peace of Christ be ruling in your hearts, as it was the purpose of God for you to be one body; and give praise to God at all times.

entries.title: Colossians 3:16
segments: Let the word of Christ be in you in all wealth of wisdom; teaching and helping one another with songs of praise and holy words, making melody to God with grace in your hearts.

entries.title: Colossians 3:17
segments: And whatever you do, in word or in act, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving praise to God the Father through him.

entries.title: Colossians 3:18
segments: ¶Wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as is right in the Lord.

entries.title: Colossians 3:19
segments: Husbands, have love for your wives, and be not bitter against them.

entries.title: Colossians 3:20
segments: Children, do the orders of your fathers and mothers in all things, for this is pleasing to the Lord.

entries.title: Colossians 3:21
segments: Fathers, do not be hard on your children, so that their spirit may not be broken.

entries.title: Colossians 3:22
segments: Servants, in all things do the orders of your natural masters; not only when their eyes are on you, as pleasers of men, but with all your heart, fearing the Lord:

entries.title: Colossians 3:23
segments: Whatever you do, do it readily, as to the Lord and not to men;

entries.title: Colossians 3:24
segments: Being certain that the Lord will give you the reward of the heritage: for you are the servants of the Lord Christ.

entries.title: Colossians 3:25
segments: For the wrongdoer will have punishment for the wrong he has done, without respect for any man's position.
